title: Annual tariff schedule comprehensive review
description: Review all IURC No. E tariff schedules on file to confirm accuracy completeness and conformance with 170 IAC 1-2 requirements. Identify any needed revisions for administrative filing.
due_date_notes: End of January; next business day if weekend/holiday
notes: RPL practice; precedes any Q1 administrative filing

title: Q1 customer service billing compliance audit
description: Verify that all customer bills include required elements per 170 IAC 4-1-13(a): dates/meter readings; units; rate code; minimum charge; previous balance; amount; delinquency date; estimated bill indicator; 17-day nonpenalty period statement.
notes: Quarterly audit; Q1 focus on 17-day nonpenalty disclosure

title: Meter testing program — annual lot draw Phase 1 (Method B)
description: Draw annual sample from each homogenous lot per ANSI/ASQC Standard Z1.9 Table A-2 using Inspection Level II. Test drawn meters for accuracy.
notes: Method B adopted by RPL; sample drawn at random from each lot

title: Customer deposit interest rate review
description: Verify deposit interest rate in force is 6% per annum or IURC-prescribed rate. Update CIS configuration if IURC modifies rate. Document review.
notes: Deposits held more than 12 months must accrue interest from deposit date

title: Administrative filing procedures annual training
description: Annual refresher training for Regulatory Affairs staff on 30-day administrative filing requirements including cover letter requirements contact information tariff sheets and work papers per 170 IAC 1-6-5(a).
due_date_notes: Mid-February; next business day if holiday
notes: Includes review of prohibited filings per 170 IAC 1-6-4 and allowable filings per 170 IAC 1-6-3

title: Q1 compliance review — disconnection and reconnection procedures
description: Review disconnection and reconnection compliance statistics. Coordinate with Credit & Collections (P15) to verify proper notice procedures and timelines. Document findings.
notes: Coordinate with P15 Jasmine Carter; see RPL-CS-PRO-004 Section 8

title: Annual compliance program self-assessment — scope setting
description: Establish scope methodology and responsible parties for full-year compliance program review. Define assessment criteria against 170 IAC requirements. See RPL-CMP-REG-001.
notes: Scope document routed to P04 (CCO) for concurrence

title: Tariff schedule accuracy verification — IURC No. E schedules
description: Verify all tariff schedules filed with IURC are internally consistent include all rules regulations and formulas that affect rates and conform to 170 IAC 1-2-2 and 170 IAC 1-5-16 formatting requirements.
notes: Shared with P09; findings reported to P10 (Manager Rates & Tariffs)

title: Q1 complaint resolution rate reporting
description: Compile Q1 customer complaint statistics including total complaints received time-to-resolution rates escalations to IURC and outcomes. See RPL-CS-PRO-011.
notes: Internal report; copy to P09 and P08

title: Reference standards certification check — biennial due diligence
description: Verify that all reference standards (indicating instruments wattmeters watthour meters) have been tested and adjusted within the prior two years by a recognized standardizing laboratory. Schedule recertification if overdue.
notes: Biennial requirement; records of certification kept per 170 IAC 4-1-7(F)

title: v1.3 calendar update — incorporate S2 amendments to 170 IAC 1-6-3/4/5
description: Prepare v1.3 update to this calendar incorporating amendments to 170 IAC 1-6-3 (allowable filings) 1-6-4 (prohibited filings) and 1-6-5 (filing requirements) that became effective 2025-01-24. Route through standard review/approval cycle.
notes: Lagging-at-approval remediation event; S2 effective 2025-01-24; O-3 not applied to v1.2

title: Q2 customer service billing compliance audit
description: Quarterly billing audit. Q2 focus: verify estimated bill identification coding on bills per 170 IAC 4-1-13(a)(9) and alternative billing method availability notice per 170 IAC 4-1-13(f)(2).
notes: Quarterly cadence; results to P09 and P08

title: Administrative filing window review — Q2
description: Review pipeline of potential administrative filings for Q2-Q3. Confirm each is an allowable filing under 170 IAC 1-6-3. Prepare timeline for any needed filings including 30-day notice window.
notes: Check that no prohibited filing per 170 IAC 1-6-4 is misclassified as administrative

title: Meter testing program — Method B lot results review
description: Evaluate lot acceptance/rejection using Double Specification Limit Standard Deviation Method per ANSI/ASQC Z1.9 Table B-3 at 2.50 AQL. Document lot disposition. Initiate accelerated testing for rejected lots per 170 IAC 4-1-10(c)(7).
notes: Accelerated testing for rejected lots must complete within 96 months

title: Mid-year tariff schedule review
description: Semi-annual review of all IURC No. E tariff schedules. Confirm schedules are complete include all formulas and are consistent with rates in effect. Document findings for annual tariff file.
notes: Second of two annual tariff reviews

title: Rate case readiness review
description: Assess financial metrics and regulatory status to determine whether a general rate case filing is warranted in 2025 or 2026. Review 10-month expedited timeline requirements. See RPL-TAR-GRR-012.
notes: Report findings to P07 (VP Regulatory & Government Affairs) and P03

title: IURC electronic portal access verification
description: Confirm all Regulatory Affairs staff have current credentials for IURC electronic filing portal at iurc.portal.in.gov. Update access list. Coordinate with IT for any credential resets.
notes: Filing portal used per 170 IAC 1-7-3(b) for electronic submissions

title: Customer deposit records annual audit
description: Verify deposit records include: customer name; current address; deposit amount; date; and all transaction records. Review unclaimed deposits held over 1 year for abandonment processing per 170 IAC 4-1-15(g)(6).
notes: Annual audit; results to P14 (Director Customer Operations)

title: Q2 complaint resolution rate reporting
description: Compile Q2 customer complaint statistics. Internal metric report. See RPL-CS-PRO-011.
notes: Internal report; copy to P09 and P08

title: Alternative billing method review
description: Confirm alternative billing method (budget billing) is included in IURC-approved tariff per 170 IAC 4-1-13(f)(1). Verify notice of availability is included in customer pamphlet per 170 IAC 4-1-13(f)(2).
notes: RPL practice; annual review cycle

title: Q3 customer service billing compliance audit
description: Quarterly billing audit. Q3 focus: spot-check delinquency notification timing (17 days after postmark per 170 IAC 4-1-13(c)) and late payment charge calculation (not to exceed 10% of first $3 and 3% of excess).
notes: Quarterly cadence

title: Administrative filing window review — Q3
description: Review pipeline of potential administrative filings for Q4 2025 and Q1 2026. Confirm allowable filing classification. Prepare filing timeline including OUCC service requirements.
notes: Flag any potential prohibited filings under 170 IAC 1-6-4 for routing to general rate case instead

title: Meter testing program — Phase 2 lot draw (if required)
description: If lot schedule requires second annual draw: draw sample from designated lots. Test for accuracy against ANSI/ASQC Z1.9 criteria.
notes: Second draw applicable only if lot schedule calls for mid-year sampling

title: Rate case data review — rate base cutoff preparation
description: Prepare test year and plant cutoff date analysis for potential rate case filing. Compile rate base data including plant in service accumulated depreciation and working capital per 170 IAC 1-5-9 and 1-5-10.
due_date_notes: Aug 29 (next business day following Aug 28 cutoff)
notes: Rate base cutoff data supports readiness review from EVT-2025-0016

title: Tariff schedule — new service rates review
description: Review whether any new service types introduced in 2025 require new rate filings under 170 IAC 1-6-3(1). Confirm administrative filing process is appropriate for each new rate.
due_date_notes: Aug 29 (Friday; next business day after Aug 28)
notes: New rate must not be an increase to existing rate (prohibited per 170 IAC 1-6-4(1))

title: Customer creditworthiness standards annual review
description: Review RPL's creditworthiness determination procedures for equity and nondiscrimination compliance. Confirm determination criteria do not consider area economic character. Verify two-year customer history and employment criteria are applied consistently.
notes: Annual review; findings to P14 and P04

title: Records retention compliance check
description: Verify all records required under 170 IAC 4-1 (meter test records billing records deposit records) are retained for minimum 3 years and stored at RPL's principal place of business or IURC-notified location. See RPL-LEG-RRS-001.
notes: Annual records audit; coordinate with P19 (meter records) and P15 (deposit records)

title: Q3 complaint resolution rate reporting
description: Compile Q3 customer complaint statistics. Internal metric report. See RPL-CS-PRO-011.
notes: Internal report; copy to P09 and P08

title: OUCC communication log review
description: Review and document all OUCC correspondence for 2025 year to date. Confirm same-day service was provided for all applicable rate case and administrative filings. Retain file per RPL-LEG-RRS-001.
notes: OUCC served same day as IURC per 170 IAC 1-5-4(e)(1) and 170 IAC 1-6-5(b)

title: Vegetation management program compliance review
description: Annual review of RPL's vegetation management program compliance with IURC service standards and applicable requirements. Coordinate with contractor performance data. See RPL-DO-PLN-002.
notes: RPL practice; coordinate with P21 (Director Distribution Operations)

title: Annual regulatory compliance self-assessment
description: Full-year compliance review per RPL-CMP-REG-001 covering all 170 IAC Articles 1 and 4 obligations. Document findings risks and remediation items. Transmit to P04 (Chief Compliance Officer).
notes: Major annual milestone; results inform 2026 compliance calendar

title: Q4 customer service billing compliance audit
description: Quarterly billing audit. Q4 focus: year-end review of all bill content requirements and verification that no prohibited bill transfers occurred per 170 IAC 4-1-13(b).
notes: Fourth and final quarterly audit

title: Annual meter testing program summary report
description: Compile full-year meter test results for all lots. Prepare tabulation by accuracy groups per 170 IAC 4-1-4(c) if required by commission. Retain records for IURC examination per 170 IAC 4-1-10(c)(9).
notes: Annual summary; retain in meter shop records; available for IURC inspection

title: Rate case — annual feasibility review and board briefing
description: Evaluate whether to initiate general rate case in 2026 based on financial metrics and regulatory landscape. Prepare case-in-chief data exhibits per 170 IAC 1-5-6 as scenario analysis. Brief P07 and P01.
notes: Decision point for 2026 planning; 10-month expected timeline per 170 IAC 1-5-2.1(a)

title: Year-end tariff schedule comprehensive review
description: Year-end review of all IURC No. E tariff schedules. Confirm all schedules remain accurate complete and consistent. Identify any needed updates for Q1 2026 administrative filings.
due_date_notes: Nov 28 — last business day before Thanksgiving holiday break (Nov 27-28 are RPL holidays)
notes: Advanced to Nov 28 to avoid Thanksgiving closure

title: Administrative filing — pre-2026 nonrecurring charge review
description: Review all nonrecurring charges (deposits returned-check fees reconnect fees tap fees) against IURC-approved tariff. Determine whether any administrative update filing needed before year-end.
due_date_notes: Nov 28 (last business day before holiday break)
notes: Nonrecurring charges defined in 170 IAC 1-6-2(11)

title: Customer complaint annual summary — regulatory affairs copy
description: Compile annual customer complaint summary for regulatory file. Include total complaints IURC referrals resolutions and trends. See RPL-CS-PRO-011.
notes: Annual regulatory file copy; original complaint records per RPL-CS-PRO-011

title: Annual compliance summary — transmit to CCO and Senior Counsel
description: Transmit final annual compliance summary to P04 (Chief Compliance Officer) and P03 (Senior Counsel Regulatory). Include all material compliance findings for 2025.
notes: Companion to EVT-2025-0031; formal transmittal document

title: 2026 regulatory compliance calendar — draft preparation
description: Begin draft of RPL-REG-CAL-2026 v1.0 incorporating any regulatory changes from 2025 including S2 amendments. Target Q1 2026 approval.
notes: RPL practice; draft for review by P08 in January 2026

title: Year-end records location notification to IURC
description: If RPL's records location has changed during 2025 notify IURC of new office location at which required records are kept per 170 IAC 4-1-3.
notes: Required only if location changed; document either way for compliance file

title: Disconnection and reconnection compliance monitoring
description: Monthly monitoring of disconnection and reconnection procedures for compliance with required notice timelines and procedures. Report anomalies to P09.
notes: Coordinate with metering services (P18) for field-side compliance

title: Meter test report delivery — customer requests
description: Deliver written report of meter test results to requesting customer within 10 days of test completion. Retain complete record on file per 170 IAC 4-1-11(d).
due_date_notes: Within 10 days of each test completion
notes: Customer appeal window is 5 days from report date per 170 IAC 4-1-11(e)

title: Customer meter test — IURC-supervised testing coordination
description: Upon IURC notification of customer application for commission-supervised meter test: do not remove or alter meter until test complete. Coordinate with IURC staff on mutually agreed conditions per 170 IAC 4-1-12(b).
notes: No fee chargeable to customer except as permitted under 170 IAC 4-1-11(b)

title: 30-day administrative filing monitoring
description: For each administrative filing submitted under 170 IAC 1-6: monitor 30-day IURC objection period from file-stamp date. Flag any objections received under section 7 of 170 IAC 1-6. Track approval or denial.
due_date_notes: Per filing; 30-day window from each IURC file-stamp date
notes: 30 days is minimum approval period; additional time may be required per 170 IAC 1-6-1(d)

title: OUCC same-day service — administrative filings
description: For each administrative filing submitted to IURC under 170 IAC 1-6: provide copy to OUCC on same day as IURC filing per 170 IAC 1-6-5(b). Document service confirmation.
due_date_notes: Same day as each IURC administrative filing
notes: Electronic or paper service acceptable per 170 IAC 1-6-5(c)

title: Billing adjustment processing — meter errors
description: When a meter is found to have error exceeding 3% (watthour) or 4% (demand): process billing adjustment per 170 IAC 4-1-14(A). Fast meter: refund or credit. Slow/stopped meter: may charge customer for up to 1 year or half the period since last test.
notes: Retroactive adjustment period: shorter of actual known period or 1 year

title: Deposit interest accrual monitoring
description: Monthly verification that customer deposits held more than 12 months are accruing interest at 6% per annum from deposit date in CIS. Correct any accrual errors.
notes: Interest accrual stops when deposit is mailed or delivered to customer per 170 IAC 4-1-15(f)(2)

title: Schedule filing receipt acknowledgment tracking
description: For any tariff schedule filing where acknowledgment is requested: transmit letter of transmittal in duplicate. Track receipt of stamped copy from IURC Secretary per 170 IAC 1-2-9.
notes: Track in document control system; retain stamped copy per RPL-LEG-RRS-001
